plan.notes: Source: 'BFA Performing Arts: Pre-Music Therapy - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Performing Arts), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. **MUTH 1093 Fundamental of Music Theory is remedial (credit does not count toward the major requirements) and is omitted from the sequence. ***MACP Class Piano I-IV sequenced at 0 credits (lower bound; the piano requirement is fulfilled by passing the proficiency exam). Two catalog extraction errors corrected against the printed semester totals: the semester-6 History choice is sequenced at 3 credits (the column-misaligned '1' is a PDF extraction artifact; 3 credits is required for the printed semester-6 total of 15) and semester-6 'MAGU 1001 Guitar 3' is sequenced at 1 credit (cross-checked against the 'Applied Guitar (4 hours)' requirement = 1+1+1+1 across semesters 5-8, and against the printed semester-6 total of 15). 'MUTP 2XX2', 'MUTP 3XX3', and 'MUTP 4XX3' kept verbatim (the catalog prints literal 'XX'). 'Sophomore Barrier Required' (semester 4) is a milestone, not a course, and is not sequenced. PSYC courses are categorized as major (the degree requires 21 hours of Psychology). Placeholder codes normalized: catalog 'MA__ 1001' etc. rendered as 'MA 1001' (primary/secondary instrument applied instruction; instrument-specific prefix); catalog 'MUEN_1__1'/'MUEN_3__1' rendered as 'MUEN 1X11'/'MUEN 3X11' (level-specific large ensembles; see Major Ensemble Electives: MUEN 1101/3101, 1171/3171, 1151/3151, 1051/2051/3051, 1061/3061, 1071/3071, 1081/3081, 1141/3141). Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. REPEATS (per SAU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog): MUED 1000 Concert/Recital Attendance is required for 6 semesters ('All music majors except musical theatre majors are required to register for MUED 1000'); MUEN ensembles (1071/3071 Instrumental Ensemble, 1141/3141 Heritage Singers, 1061/3061 Chamber Singers, 3051 Marching Band) and applied instruction (MAVC Voice, MAGU Guitar) are sequenced every term per the catalog plans; allow_repeated_courses set 2026-10-01.
